notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Rangers of Ithilien trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
